sources.title: 豆包大模型 1.6 系列上线边缘大模型网关
sources.evidence: Official Edge Cloud account states the June 11 launch included doubao-seed-1.6-flash. Direct HTML contains the article, official team attribution, and July 2025 publication metadata. Reopened October 27 via direct HTML after web-reader timeout. The article distinguishes three named models and describes Flash latency/capabilities, without a parameter count or an explicit shared-base relationship.

sources.title: Model releases - 2025
sources.evidence: July provider-release table names ByteDance Seed 1.6 Flash 250615 as a low-latency multimodal model with deep thinking enabled by default and switchable off.

sources.title: Model list
sources.evidence: Exact Flash 250615 and 250715 rows list deep reasoning, text generation, multimodal understanding, tool use, and 256K context. They appear under retiring models; documentation is not a live endpoint test. Reopened October 27: exact retiring Flash 250615/250715 rows still provide capabilities and limits, with no total/activated-parameter column or sized-base mapping.

sources.title: Built on Seed1.6-Flash, Seed-1.6-Embedding Launched
sources.evidence: June 28, 2025 post says its embedding derivative preserves Flash understanding of text, images and video. The stated dual-tower structure describes the embedding derivative, not an exact Flash decoder architecture. Reopened October 27. The explicit lineage runs from Flash to the embedding derivative; neither model has a published count here, and the post does not map Flash to the 230B Seed1.6 base.

sources.title: Seed1.6 technical introduction
sources.evidence: Indexed primary introduction gives 230B total and 23B active parameters for Seed1.6, without explicitly assigning them to Flash. Live HTML omits the article body. These larger-model counts are not transferred to Flash.

sources.title: Seed1.8 Model Card
sources.evidence: Later first-party card checked for exact Flash disclosures; it compares Seed1.6 but does not name Flash or supply Flash parameter counts or architecture. Independently inspected October 27 from the same-day official PDF cache at /tmp/model130-reaudit/seed18.txt. Generic Seed1.6 comparisons cover reasoning efficiency; no Flash entry or parameter-count table was found.

sources.title: Seed2.0 Model Card
sources.evidence: Downloaded official PDF and extracted its text after web-reader size failure. No exact Seed1.6 Flash parameter or architecture disclosure found. Independently inspected October 27 from the same-day official PDF cache at /tmp/model130-reaudit/seed20.txt. The introduction names generic Seed1.6/1.8; no exact Flash entry, size-bearing lineage or activated-parameter table was found.

sources.title: Seed2.1 Model Card
sources.evidence: Downloaded official PDF and extracted its text after web-reader timeout. No exact Seed1.6 Flash parameter or architecture disclosure found. Independently inspected October 27 from the same-day official PDF cache at /tmp/model130-reaudit/seed21.txt. Exact-model and parameter-term searches found no Flash count or lineage; parameter occurrences concern code/task examples.

sources.title: BytePlus service-specific terms, June 16 2026 version
sources.evidence: Indexed archived Model Services terms reserve model-parameter and framework IP, grant limited service access, and prohibit parameter extraction. Live HTML exposes metadata only. Supports descriptive proprietary service classification, not a weights license.

sources.title: Introduction to Techniques Used in Seed1.6
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved full English and embedded Chinese article via curl on October 27 after web-reader timeouts. It discloses 230B total/23B active for the Seed1.6 pretrained base and explicitly names Thinking and Adaptive CoT as its two post-trained variants. Flash is absent from the article; its shared family name alone does not establish the same base or activation pattern.

sources.title: Seed2.0 Model Card: Towards Intelligence Frontier for Real-World Complexity
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the full June card from the same-day official-PDF cache at /tmp/model130-reaudit/seed20_june.txt. Its introduction and bibliography cite generic Seed1.6, but provide no Flash-specific count, base mapping or activated-parameter column.

sources.title: Coze model release notes
sources.evidence: Opened October 27. The June 25 comparison lists generic Seed1.6, Thinking and Flash separately; the October 28 update compares Flash 250828 with earlier Flash versions. These are capability/speed comparisons, with no numeric parameter counts or statement that Flash preserves the disclosed 230B/23B base.

sources.title: TheRouter Seed1.6 Flash numeric claim
sources.evidence: Opened October 27 solely to resolve the concrete 230B/23B lead. It asserts that Flash uses the same architecture but cites the generic Seed1.6 introduction, which does not mention Flash. No additional developer evidence establishes the asserted mapping; the secondary transfer is not accepted as a specification.

sources.title: Doubao Seed 1.6 Flash 250615: Latest Update & Features
sources.evidence: Opened October 27 to resolve the 180B numeric search lead. The model-size table and its note explicitly label the values illustrative, not actual model specifications. No developer count supports the figure.

sources.title: Doubao Seed 1.6 Flash 250615: Key Features & Updates
sources.evidence: Opened October 27 to resolve 100B language plus 30B vision claims. The section explicitly introduces hypothetical specifications and supplies no developer evidence. It is not used for size or architecture.

name.note: Normalized spelling of the exact Flash variant.

developer.note: Named model provider and Seed research publisher.

family.note: Flash is one of the Seed 1.6 series models.

release_date.note: Earliest public launch explicitly includes Flash. July is BytePlus availability; August 28 is a later revision, not this undated model's first release.

open_weights.note: Documented distribution is the proprietary hosted service; reviewed first-party materials provide no public Flash checkpoint.

license.note: Descriptive service-license classification; no open-weight license is documented.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 original-source, later-card and English/Chinese nominal-size/lineage searches found no supported Flash total. The disclosed 230B Seed1.6 base is explicitly linked to Thinking and Adaptive CoT, but not Flash. TheRouter transfers that generic count without additional lineage; XRoute values are expressly illustrative or hypothetical. Null reflects missing nominal disclosure or a supported sized-base mapping, not an exact-tensor-census requirement.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 active/activated-count searches and four later first-party cards found no Flash active count or activated-parameter column. The generic Seed1.6 23B count has no explicit Flash mapping. Latency, optional thinking and the embedding derivative relationship do not establish a count; no equality with total parameters is inferred.

architecture.note: Flash-specific topology is not disclosed in reviewed sources, including targeted architecture/research searches. Neither Seed1.6 MoE nor the embedding derivative's dual-tower design establishes it.

context_window.note: Official exact-version rows specify 256K; retained as nominal decimal-token notation, rather than a gateway's 262144 interpretation.

modalities.note: The Flash-based embedding post explicitly identifies the base model's text/image/video understanding; model list confirms text generation.

reasoning.note: Flash has optional deep thinking, enabled by default in its original provider announcement.

tool_call.note: Tool use is explicitly listed for both Flash versions.

description.value: ByteDance multimodal model with optional thinking, text, image and video input, and tool calling.
description.note: Replaces unsupported extraction/high-throughput positioning with documented capabilities.

patch.description: ByteDance multimodal model with optional thinking, text, image and video input, and tool calling.
patch.notes: Nominal total and active counts remain undisclosed: no developer source maps Flash to the published 230B/23B Seed1.6 base. Flash topology also remains undisclosed. 256K context is the provider's nominal notation. Earliest public Flash launch was June 11, 2025; later provider dates and snapshot suffixes do not replace it.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains null/undisclosed total and active counts after fresh original release/technical-post review, four later cards, exact-version comparisons and English/Chinese searches. The 230B/23B secondary claim transfers generic Seed1.6 specifications without Flash lineage; 180B and 100B+30B leads are explicitly illustrative/hypothetical. All unrelated assessments and existing release/context precision are preserved.
